styleLock.direction: clean basics-apparel ecommerce with minimal infographic screens
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless studio cyclorama #FFFFFF for the packshot, warm off-white flat field #FBFAF8 for the callout screen, oat-toned plaster interior panelling #EFE9E0 and #E4DBCE for scenes, all kept low-contrast so the knit reads first
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft 5600-5700K daylight-balanced key from upper left with gentle wrap fill, low-contrast contact shadows only, skimming light on knit textures, no harsh flash, no mixed colour casts
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte plaster wall with shallow mouldings, pale wood side table, and the heathered knit surface of the garment itself as the macro surface
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family, light letter-spaced kicker above short callout lines, in-image copy only as bracketed placeholders, headline 24-32pt, labels 12-16pt, no dense body text
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line rules and markers only, no filled 3D icons, no seals, no authority badges
styleLock.presentationRules: one generic unidentifiable model with the head cropped above the chin or turned away, crew rib and sleeve line always readable, stable front read across scenes so the garment reads as the same object, consistent scale, relaxed fully formed hands
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting direction or colour temperature
no mismatched line-marker or icon styles
no identifiable model faces or source likeness
no brand marks, watermarks or QR codes
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean basics-apparel ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio field #FFFFFF, oat warm background #EFE7DB, charcoal type #33373B and one soft sprout-green accent #A8B98F; neutral colour temperature throughout; one modern geometric sans-serif family with a light letter-spaced kicker above short callout lines, all rendered in-image copy wrapped in corner brackets and never as dense body text; background system of a seamless studio cyclorama, a warm off-white flat callout field and oat-toned plaster interior panelling; lighting system of bright soft 5600-5700K daylight-balanced key from upper left with gentle wrap fill, low-contrast contact shadows only, skimming light on knit surfaces, no harsh flash and no mixed colour casts; surface system of matte plaster mouldings, pale wood and the heathered knit fabric itself; layout system of generous margins, thin single-weight rules, one two-column image-plus-callout screen and consistent rounded card corners; icon system of thin single-weight line markers only, no filled 3D icons, no seals, no authority badges; product presentation rules: one generic unidentifiable model with the head cropped above the chin or turned away, readable crew rib and sleeve line, stable scale and consistent front read, relaxed fully formed hands; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no identifiable faces, no brand marks, no watermarks.

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清版型与前胸轮廓，用无干扰的合规主图争点击。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level front read, model framed from hips up, head cropped above the chin so no face enters frame
shots.lighting: bright high-key 5600K softbox key from front-left with a bounce card opening the shadow side, soft contact shadow under the hem
shots.background: seamless studio cyclorama #FFFFFF with no visible horizon seam
shots.whitespace: even margins on all four sides, no copy block
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level front read on one generic unidentifiable model framed from the hips up with the head cropped above the chin, the whole garment silhouette visible and unclipped. Bright high-key 5600K softbox key from the front-left with a bounce card opening the shadow side, one soft contact shadow under the hem so the fabric is grounded. Seamless studio cyclorama #FFFFFF with no visible horizon seam and no props. The garment occupies 60-70% of the frame, with even margins on all four sides and no copy block anywhere. Honest heathered knit surface, natural fall at the waist, crisp shoulder and sleeve edges. Negative: no in-image text, no watermark, no brand marks, no props, no identifiable face, no jewellery catching light, no garment floating without contact shadow, no plastic-smoothed fabric, no over-retouched skin, no cut-off sleeve or hem edges.

shots.intent: 一秒法则：左衣右文两栏版面，用三条极短主张交代穿着体感与适用场合。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level torso on the left two-thirds of the frame with the head out of frame, right third held as a flat graphic field
shots.lighting: even soft 5700K high-key light from the front, minimal shadow, no hotspot on the graphic side
shots.background: flat warm off-white field #FBFAF8 continuing seamlessly behind the torso
shots.props: none beyond the garment on the generic model
shots.whitespace: the right 35% held as a clean callout column with wide left-aligned gutters
shots.textZone: 右栏三行细线分隔主张「{selling_point_1}」「{selling_point_2}」「{selling_point_3}」，取值由真实卖点填充
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}, two-column screen. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level torso on the left two-thirds of the frame with the head cropped out of frame, the right third held as a flat graphic callout column. Even soft 5700K high-key light from the front, minimal shadow and no hotspot on the graphic side. Background is a flat warm off-white field #FBFAF8 continuing seamlessly behind the torso, no props. The garment occupies 50-60% of the frame, with the right 35% kept clean for copy. Text zone: a light letter-spaced kicker, then three short right-aligned lines separated by thin single-weight rules in #33373B reading 「{selling_point_1}」, 「{selling_point_2}」 and 「{selling_point_3}」 at 20-24pt, one accent hairline in #A8B98F under the kicker; wording is supplied later from real product data. Keep knit surface believable and edges crisp. Negative: no wording beyond the three bracketed callout lines, no invented fabric composition percentages or test data, no dense body text, no watermark, no brand marks, no identifiable face, no more than three claims.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 浅麻白圆领短袖上衣髋部以上平视棚拍、下颌以上裁切；002 明亮居家内景、手持外带杯、侧桌绿植小花瓶；003 同内景、手轻拉侧下摆展示弧形开衩与垂坠；004 左衣右文两栏版式、三行英文主张以细线分隔；005 后侧 45 度展示无装饰后背与后领；006 领口罗纹与肩颈织纹微距。变体闸门核查：6 图为同一件素色上衣的六种不同构图与机位（前脸/场景/下摆/后背/领口微距/两栏信息图），并非同构图仅换色的色卡陈列，也不含混合套装，故按正常转化处理。品类判定以图为准：女装 / 上衣，与源类目路径一致无冲突，leaf 取女式圆领短袖弹力基础T恤。已剥离：原品牌字标与店铺字样、模特面容与身份（一律改为头颈裁切或侧背回避）、项链与耳环等配饰、外带杯上的字样、004 三行原始英文主张与面料配比成分字样（改为 {selling_point_*} 占位，取值留给真实商品数据）、源平台徽章与星级社会证明；全套不含任何未经核实的数值、成分、检测或资质主张。
